nodes.label: nocloud package residue
nodes.rationale: Purging cloud-guest-utils cannot undo util-linux upgrades; purge is closest to stock

nodes.label: Corpus scope decision
nodes.rationale: Graph covers README, docs, dev lab, agent scripts and specs; .graphifyignore excludes tool state, assets, license and VM seed data

nodes.label: Leiden clustering decision
nodes.rationale: Louvain can produce internally disconnected communities; leiden extra installs graspologic-native on Python 3.13+

nodes.label: No CI gate decision
nodes.rationale: Hooks are the only freshness enforcement; add check-graph-fresh.sh to CI once CI exists

nodes.label: Committed graph decision
nodes.rationale: graph.json is committed so a fresh clone can query without rebuild; union merge driver only keeps conflict markers out; hooks rebuild the graph

nodes.label: Tracked hooks decision
nodes.rationale: Graphify's own rebuild hooks are not used; tracked pre-commit and pre-push hooks replace them and run in every worktree

nodes.label: Immutable goldens
nodes.rationale: Goldens are booted once then chmod a-w; tests run on qcow2 overlays

nodes.label: Serial console only decision
nodes.rationale: No SSH: SSH would be part of the system under test and not a trustworthy control channel
